title: HR Development (L&D)
description:
**About the Job** 




 As a specialist in electronics and software for the past 20 years, in\-tech is a dynamic, fast\-growing engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany employing around 2350 employees globally across 20 project locations in 8 countries.
 



 in\-tech develops innovative engineering solutions for the automotive, rail, aerospace, defence, and industrial sectors.
 



 We are committed to a flexible, modern work culture and work\-life balance. Our colour orange stands for liveliness, warmth, and dynamism. We value a strong team spirit, fresh ideas and a positive work culture. We call it the “Orange Spirit”!
 



 Since 2024, in\-tech became a subsidiary of Infosys Ltd.This role is responsible for coordinating, delivering, and maintaining training and development programs for freshers and junior team members in the automotive engineering services domain, working closely with German in\-house training teams, project managers, technical leads, and HR. The ideal candidate has 3\+ years of experience in L\&D or HR development, strong communication and organizational skills, and a hands\-on, collaborative mindset within a technical or automotive environment. If you’re passionate about joining a growing and dynamic team with a company with a positive culture and team spirit, we’d love to connect with you!
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Support the design and implementation of training programs in close collaboration with our German in\-house training team and Infosys training programs, with a focus on administrative coordination and operational execution.
* Tailor and maintain training content to engage and upskill freshers and junior resources in the automotive engineering services domain.
* Collaborate with in\-house project managers, technical leads, and the HR Business Partner to identify skill gaps and training needs.
* Coordinate and administer onboarding sessions to familiarize freshers with company organizational processes, tools, technologies, and company values.
* Maintain and update technical and soft skills training modules to enhance the capabilities of team members.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to freshers, ensuring a smooth transition into project roles.
* Track and document the progress of trainees, provide constructive feedback, and maintain reporting on training KPIs.
* Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), including scheduling, enrolment, content uploads, and reporting.
* Stay updated on industry trends and advancements to incorporate relevant knowledge into training programs.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment of training objectives with project requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and report on their impact on employee skills development.
* Support engineering team members with additional training coordination during transitions between projects.
* Handle day\-to\-day administrative tasks related to HR development activities, including training logistics, documentation, and communication with stakeholders.
* Support planning, coordinating and steering all global developmental processes, including talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and performance management.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor's or master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience of at least 3\+ years in a learning \& development, training administration, or HR development role \- ideally within the automotive sector or a similar digital/technical services environment.
* Solid understanding of training coordination processes and HR development practices.
* Familiarity with automotive engineering principles, tools, and technologies is an advantage.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to coordinate and deliver engaging training content for freshers and junior resources with a positive and supportive approach.
* Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and related administrative tools.
* Knowledge of SuccessFactors and SAP would be beneficial but not essential.
* Strong organizational skills with a hands\-on, operative mindset.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team structure, supporting HR Business Partners and German\-based L\&D leadership on project\-level topics.
* Should be willing to assist in managing all kind of processes \& projects in the HR development field.



  





**Apply with us** 




 If you have experience and team spirit and are looking for a great place to work, then start your job with us.
 



 As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, in\-tech is committed to equal employment opportunity without regard for age, race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

title: Senior Manager – Recruitment
description:
📍 Location: Infopark Phase 2 ,Kochi,Kerala
 



 💼 Experience: 6\-8 years
 



 🏢 Work Model: Work From Office/General Shift
 



  





 The Senior Manager – Recruitment will lead and manage the end\-to\-end talent acquisition function, ensuring achievement of hiring targets within defined timelines, budget guidelines, and quality standards. The role involves driving sourcing strategies, managing recruitment teams, overseeing stakeholder and vendor management, optimizing recruitment processes, and ensuring a strong candidate experience while aligning hiring delivery with business objectives.
 



  





**Duties and responsibilities:** 




  





**Recruitment Strategy \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, workforce plans, and hiring priorities.
* Develop recruitment strategies for volume, niche, and leadership hiring requirements.
* Create sourcing plans aligned to business expansion, attrition trends, and critical skill requirements.
* Drive recruitment process improvements to enhance efficiency, candidate quality, and hiring outcomes.



**Team Management** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of recruiters and sourcing specialists.
* Allocate requisitions based on recruiter capability, bandwidth, and business priority.
* Monitor team productivity, sourcing effectiveness, and recruitment pipeline health.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and capability\-building initiatives for the recruitment team.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment SLAs, policies, and compliance standards



**Talent Sourcing \& Networking** 



* Oversee sourcing activities across multiple channels including job portals, employee referrals, social media platforms, consultants, and internal databases.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for critical and recurring positions.
* Develop market intelligence on talent availability, compensation trends, and competitor hiring practices.
* Strengthen employer branding initiatives to improve talent attraction.



**Screening \& Selection** 



* Guide recruiters in candidate assessment and shortlisting processes to ensure hiring quality.
* Ensure structured screening and interview processes are followed across all business units.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to ensure timely interview feedback and decision\-making.
* Monitor selection quality and ensure alignment with competency and cultural fit requirements.



**Stakeholder \& Candidate Management** 



* Build strong working relationships with business leaders and hiring stakeholders.
* Ensure seamless and professional candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Handle escalations related to recruitment delivery, offer negotiations, and candidate engagement.



**Recruitment Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure accurate maintenance of recruitment data, reports, and ATS records.
* Monitor recruitment metrics, dashboards, and periodic hiring reports.
* Ensure compliance with company recruitment policies, audit requirements, and documentation standards.
* Support HR audits and management reviews related to talent acquisition processes.



**Recruitment Budget Planning** 



* Prepare and manage the annual recruitment budget in alignment with workforce planning and business hiring projections.
* Monitor recruitment\-related expenses including job portals, consultancy fees, campus hiring, employee referral payouts, travel expenses etc.
* Track budget utilization against approved allocations and ensure cost\-effective hiring practices.
* Coordinate with Finance and Business Heads for recruitment forecasting and manpower budgeting exercises.



**External Vendor Management** 



* Manage external recruitment vendors, job portals, and hiring partners to support recruitment activities
* Coordinate and monitor recruitment processes related to consultants, agencies, and sourcing platforms to ensure effective hiring support.
* Oversee the usage and performance of job portals and external hiring channels to improve sourcing efficiency and recruitment outcomes.
* Ensure recruitment activities comply with labour laws and internal HR policies.
* Support employer branding initiatives by promoting company culture and values through job postings and social media platforms.



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 




  




* MBA in HR stream or Graduation in any discipline
* 10\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing a recruitment team.
* Experience handling volume hiring, niche hiring, and stakeholder management.
* Exposure to ATS platforms, job portals, market standards and recruitment analytics preferred.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
   

  

 The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling \& Staffing Support**
* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.


**Capacity, Utilization \& Workforce Analytics**
* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision\-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity\-related information as requested by management.


**Coordination \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.


**Process \& Administrative Support**
* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2\-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.


**Core Competencies**
 Resource Coordination
   

  

 Relationship Management
   

  

 Schedule Management
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Tracking
   

  

 Business Acumen
   

  

 Workforce Analytics
   

  

 Time Management
   

  

 Operational Support
   

  

 Attention to Detail
   

  

 Data Accuracy \& Reporting
   

  

 Adaptability
   

  

**Success Measures**
* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision\-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.

 \* Ensure a positive candidate experience through clear communication and timely updates throughout the recruitment process.
 



 \* Negotiate and discuss salary expectations, notice periods, availability, and other relevant employment details with candidates.
 



 \* Prepare recruitment\-related reports and track key hiring metrics such as sourcing, interviews, selections, offers, and joining conversions.
 



 \* Assist in preparing and issuing offer letters, appointment letters, and other recruitment\-related documentation.
 



 \* Coordinate the onboarding process for selected candidates and ensure all required documents are collected.
 



 \* Support employee engagement, HR operations, and other HR activities whenever required.
 



 \* Stay updated on current IT recruitment trends, talent availability, and sourcing strategies.

 \* MBA in Human Resources Management or a Master’s degree in HRM is mandatory.
 



 \* Minimum 1 year of experience in IT recruitment or technical recruitment.
 



 \* Good understanding of IT roles, technical skills, and recruitment terminology.
 



 \* Hands\-on experience with job portals, LinkedIn, recruitment databases, and other sourcing platforms.
 



 \* Strong candidate sourcing, screening, and interviewing skills.
 



 \* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
 



 \* Strong follow\-up and negotiation skills.
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and candidates simultaneously.
 



 \* Target\-oriented with a proactive and result\-driven approach.
 



 \* Good knowledge of MS Office, HRMS, Excel/Google Sheets, and recruitment tracking tools.
 



 \* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
 



 \* Ability to work independently and meet recruitment deadlines and targets.
 



 \* Professional approach while handling confidential candidate and employee information.
 



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





 \* Experience in recruiting for roles such as Software Developers, QA/Testers, UI/UX Designers, Digital Marketing, IT Support, Data/Business Analysts, and other technical positions.
 



 \* Familiarity with ATS/recruitment management systems.
 



 \* Experience in working with recruitment targets and hiring metrics.

 Full\-Time

title: HR Operations & Executive Assistant
description:
KOCHI, KL, India
   

  

 Apply Now!
   

  

**Location:** 
 On\-site / Hybrid (Kochi, Kerala)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–4 years in an IT consulting, software services, or staffing agency environment
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Infintor Solutions is seeking a proactive, highly organized
 **HR Operations \& Executive Assistant** 
 to streamline our internal business operations and support executive leadership.
   

  

 In this dual\-capacity role, you will serve as the administrative backbone of our team—owning human resources administration, talent acquisition, timesheet coordination, employee engagement, basic financial coordination, and high\-level executive assistance for Management. You will act as the primary point of contact for internal team queries, establishing clear operational boundaries and enabling leadership to focus on driving core company growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Operations, Recruitment \& Talent Coordination
* Talent Acquisition \& Pipeline Management: Lead recruitment drives for internal requirements and staff augmentation clients. Source candidates, screen resumes, schedule interviews, and maintain an active talent pool for fast deployment.
* Leave \& Timesheet Management: Own the leave management system and enforce strict weekly/monthly timesheet submission schedules across all business units.
* Onboarding \& Offboarding Logistics: Oversee end\-to\-end onboarding for new hires and interns—including offer letters, non\-disclosure agreements (NDAs), system asset allocation, and orientation schedules.
* Internship Mentoring \& Training Coordination: Structure internship mentoring plans, schedule technical training sessions with senior team leads, and monitor intern progress.
* Employee Engagement \& Culture: Plan and execute internal employee engagement activities, team outings, festival celebrations, and wellness initiatives to build a strong workplace culture.
* Personnel Records Maintenance: Maintain digital personnel files, employment contracts, internship completion certificates, and company policy manuals.
* Executive Assistance \& Operational Coordination
* Task Planning \& Follow\-Up Coordination: Assist management in tracking cross\-departmental action items, setting task priorities, and following up with team leads on project/admin deadlines.
* Executive Calendar \& Sales Scheduling: Manage executive calendars, schedule client discovery calls, and resolve meeting conflicts across domestic and international time zones.
* Communication Buffer: Serve as the primary internal buffer—filtering routine operational inquiries from team members and directing them to established standard operating procedures before escalating to leadership.
* Meeting Documentation: Attend key strategy, leadership, and operational review meetings to record action items, assign owners, and track completion deadlines.
* Financial Admin \& Accounts Support
* Invoicing \& Accounts Receivable Support: Draft milestone\-based and time\-and\-materials (T\&M) client invoices based on approved timesheets, maintain billing schedules, and conduct polite, structured follow\-ups on overdue accounts.
* Payroll Input \& CA Coordination: Prepare monthly payroll inputs by the 25th of every month (based on approved timesheets and leave records), coordinate with our external Chartered Accountant (CA) firm, and distribute payslips on payday.
* CA \& Expense Assembly: Collect vendor bills, receipts, and recurring software subscription invoices, categorizing them for monthly handover to our external CA firm.
* Asset \& Facilities Management: Maintain the company hardware asset register (laptops, monitors, mobile devices) and coordinate office facility vendor support.


**Key Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration (BBA), Commerce (B.Com), HR, or a related field.
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in HR operations, talent acquisition, or executive assistance within an IT consulting or staff augmentation agency.
* Core Competencies \& Tool Skills:
+ Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace / MS Office (specifically Google Sheets / Excel for tracking timesheets and invoicing).
+ Hands\-on experience with modern HRMS platforms, leave/timesheet tracking tools, or Odoo modules.
+ Familiarity with recruitment sourcing channels (LinkedIn, job portals) and basic invoicing workflows.

* Soft Skills:
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
+ High level of discretion and integrity when managing sensitive salary, financial, and personal data.
+ Firm, assertive, and professional communication style capable of enforcing timesheet submission deadlines and following up on overdue client invoices independently.

title: eLearning Developer and LMS administrator – Global HR
description:
****About Us****
 Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.
   

  

 For the better. Together.
   

  

**About The Job**
* Design and build engaging eLearning modules for a range of learning and development initiatives, from onboarding and compliance to leadership and functional skills.
* Develop and maintain eLearning content that supports the continuous upskilling of Workday capabilities across the organization.
* Apply instructional design principles to turn complex topics into clear, structured, learner\-friendly experiences.
* Administer and maintain our learning management system (LMS365\): manage courses and catalogues, user accounts and permissions, enrolments, learning paths, and certificates.
* Keep the platform healthy and current: handle configuration, routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and coordination with IT and the vendor on issues and updates.
* Provide administrative and first\-line support to stakeholders and learners: respond to requests, set up training, resolve access and content questions, and keep records accurate.
* Build and run reports and dashboards on learning activity, completion, and compliance, and share clear updates with the teams that need them.
* Apply sound graphic design and UI/UX principles so content is visually clear, on brand, and easy to navigate.
* Manage stakeholders across the business: gather requirements, align with project owners, and keep people informed on progress.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with HR, IT, and operational teams so both content and platform reflect real business needs.
* Manage your own workload across content projects and ongoing platform tasks, balancing priorities and deadlines with limited supervision.


**About You**
 Must\-have
   

  

* At least three years of relevant experience in eLearning development, instructional design, or learning platform administration, ideally in logistics, technology, HR, or organizational development.
* Hands\-on proficiency with Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise), with work samples you can share.
* Direct experience administering LMS365 specifically, including user, course, and reporting administration.
* Solid grounding in instructional design and structuring content for adult learners.
* A good eye for graphic design, UI, and UX, and the ability to produce clean, accessible material.
* Strong project, time, and workload management, with a track record of juggling content work and day\-to\-day platform tasks.
* Confident stakeholder management, cross\-functional collaboration, and a service\-minded approach to supporting learners.
* Genuine curiosity and the ability to learn new tools, topics, and systems quickly.
* Professional written and spoken English, since you will work with colleagues across regions.


 Nice\-to\-have
   

  

* Practical experience building or maintaining Workday training content, or familiarity with the Workday platform.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (such as WCAG) and SCORM or xAPI publishing.
* Exposure to a global or multi\-site organization.


 What success looks like after one year
   

  

* A steady stream of eLearning modules designed, built, and released on time for the priority L\&D initiatives.
* Workday upskilling content is live, widely used, and kept current.
* LMS365 runs smoothly: content, users, and enrollments are well organized, and issues are resolved quickly.
* Stakeholders and learners get fast, reliable support and see this person as their go\-to for anything learning related.
* Reporting on completion and compliance is accurate, regular, and trusted by the teams that rely on it.
* Content is clear, accessible, on brand, and rarely needs rework after release.
* A more structured, repeatable way of building content and running the platform is in place.
* Learning content is rolled out smoothly and consistently across the relevant regions and teams.
* The person owns both their content projects and platform administration end to end.

title: HR Executive
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **HR Executive** 
 to manage end\-to\-end HR operations and administration for the organization. The role will be responsible for talent acquisition, manpower planning, employee engagement, performance management, statutory compliance, employee relations and HR administration.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Planning**
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for plant and corporate positions.
* Develop manpower plans based on business and operational requirements.
* Manage onboarding, induction, employee documentation and exits.
* Partner with business heads to identify current and future manpower requirements.


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Manage PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and other statutory compliances.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR MIS and personnel documentation.
* Coordinate statutory audits, inspections and compliance activities.


**Employee Relations \& Engagement**
* Handle employee queries, grievances and disciplinary matters.
* Maintain positive employee relations and workplace culture.
* Drive employee engagement, welfare and retention initiatives.
* Support industrial relations and shop\-floor employee matters.


**Performance Management \& Training**
* Coordinate performance appraisal and review processes.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Coordinate employee training, learning and development initiatives.
* Monitor training effectiveness and employee development.


**Payroll \& HR Administration**
* Coordinate payroll inputs, attendance, leave and employee master data.
* Work closely with Finance/payroll vendors to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Manage HR policies, procedures and employee communication.
* Oversee general administration, facilities and vendor coordination as required.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree with MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* 2\+ years of experience in HR Generalist / HR Operations roles.
* Experience in manufacturing / engineering / industrial environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management and HR operations.
* Good knowledge of PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Factory Act and POSH.
* Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Office and HRMS.


 Skills: compliance,employee relations,hr operations
